description: Atoms where CAPS deliberately differs from a DL_FIELD 4.13 template: the template contradicts the force field's own typer, or the CAPS force-field file has no such type. The sweep (bench/typing/sweep_dlfield.sh) reports these as explained, not as matches.

deviations.reason: antechamber 22.0 (AmberTools 23.6), GAFF's own typer, gives DMSO's methyl H h1 (docs/paper/runs/checks_1012/antechamber_gaff/dmso.ac_gaff.mol2)
antechamber gives DMSO's methyl H h1 in GAFF2 too (dmso.ac_gaff2.mol2)
antechamber gives the H on ethylene glycol's carbons h1 (ethylene_glycol.ac_gaff2.mol2); the library's own GAFF (AMBER16) template has h1 as well
antechamber gives the H on ethyl acetate's O-CH2 h1 (ethyl_acetate.ac_gaff2.mol2); the library's own GAFF (AMBER16) template has h1 as well
pcff.frc (the class II file pcff-frc reads) has no sodium type; the DL-derived pcff entry types it SOD
CGenFF's own topology (top_all36_cgenff.rtf, RESI THFO) gives the H on 3-hydroxy-THF's C3 HGA1
the template keeps the placeholder HA (no parameters); CGenFF (top_all36_cgenff.rtf, RESI EPHE) has HGA3
the template keeps the placeholder HA (no parameters); CGenFF (top_all36_cgenff.rtf, RESI EPHE) has HGA2

excluded.reason: the template's CONNECT records bond H12 to C2 and H13 to C3 (they belong on C1): the molecule it describes is not but-2-yne

auto_typing.environment: a C=C carbon next to a halogen-bearing alkene carbon
auto_typing.dl: c=2 on some (chloroethene =CH2, 1-chloropropene =CH-, 2-chlorobut-2-ene, vinyl bromide), c= on others (2-chloropropene =CH2)
auto_typing.caps: c= / c=1 by pcff.frc's own definitions (c= 'non aromatic end doubly bonded carbon', c=1 'next to end doubly bonded carbon', c=2 'non aromatic doubly bonded carbon', used by CAPS for carbons conjugated on both ends)
auto_typing.reason: DL_FIELD's automatic typing gives the terminal =CH2 of chloroethene c=2 but the same =CH2 of 2-chloropropene c= (independent of atom order, checked both ways); no rule in pcff.frc's type definitions separates them, so CAPS keeps the definitions. Polymers affected: polychloroprene (P097, P206), 4 atoms each

parameters.environment: a quaternary sp3 carbon (cvff type c with four heavy neighbours: methacrylate backbones, polyisobutylene, 4,4-dimethyl-1-pentene, HFP)
parameters.dl: Lennard-Jones eps 0.0390 kcal/mol, sigma 3.875 A (cvff.frc's values for cg)
parameters.reason: DL_FIELD labels the atom c but gives it cg's nonbond parameters; CAPS takes the type's own entry. Polymers: P009, P019, P021, P059, P062, P096, P202, P210 (8 atoms each)

parameters.environment: every class II cross term (bond-bond, bond-angle, angle-angle, middle/end-bond-torsion, angle-torsion, angle-angle-torsion, bond-bond-1-3)
parameters.dl: left out of DL_FIELD's LAMMPS files (quartic angles and Fourier torsions only)
parameters.caps: every term pcff.frc defines, as msi2lmp writes them
parameters.reason: DL_FIELD's bonded energies differ from CAPS's and msi2lmp's on every PCFF polymer for this reason alone; the parameters both write are equal

parameters.environment: angle-angle at an sp2 C=C carbon with neighbours (c, c=, h) (diene rubbers: polybutadiene, polyisoprene, polychloroprene) and at the amide N of N,N-dimethylacrylamide / N-vinylpyrrolidone
parameters.dl: msi2lmp -6.5349 (pcff.frc's c= c c= h) and 3.9738 (c c n c_1): keys whose centre (second atom) is a carbon, matched backwards
parameters.caps: 0 (no c=-centred entry) and -5.1828 (c n c c_1, the N-centred entry)
parameters.reason: an angle-angle key i-j-k-l couples angles i-j-k and k-j-l about j; read backwards its centre moves to k, a coupling fitted about another atom and its reference angles. msi2lmp's find_match allows the reversal (written for torsions); these are the only differences from msi2lmp on the 98 PCFF polymers
